model_runtime_description: Codex, an agent based on GPT-6
solver: Primary: newly written unweighted/weighted bitset clique searches. General fallback: Glucose4 via python-sat 1.9.dev17. Diagnostic CP-SAT: OR-Tools 9.15.6755.
independence: No excluded C16 scientific material was read. Only the spec and four listed inputs informed the algorithms. Runtime/network skill and policy were read for environment setup. Generic installed solver/library software used. Prior parent research was not supplied. Procedural independence cannot establish algorithmic novelty or exclude convergence or pretrained exposure. Exact runtime model build not supplied.
review: Separate read-only agent reviewed all mathematical reductions, rank/degree constraints, counters, coloring bounds, timeouts, and witness checking using only new source and allowed specification. It reported no excluded-content reads or experiments.
resource_policy: All experimental search processes pinned to CPUs 0-1. Final from-scratch driver uses two single-worker child processes. Recorded portfolio shared the same affinity; redundant SAT B paused until its original wall deadline, with event log. A/B original deadline 2026-11-03T01:05:37Z; each real class has approximately two-hour budget. Construction/checking not hard-killed.
solver_binary_build_compilers: Unavailable: installed prebuilt OR-Tools and PySAT wheels do not supply verified build compiler identifiers here.

final_methods.A: checked orbit reduction + unweighted clique coloring
final_methods.B: checked symmetric-component reduction + weighted clique coloring; general SAT fallback
final_methods.C: checked tau8-column-mapped symmetric-component reduction + weighted clique coloring; general SAT fallback
final_methods.quarter: checked orbit reduction + unweighted clique coloring

orbit_clique.fixtures: newly generated 2x2 exhaustive ternary matrices and deterministic random 4x4 matrices; no external inputs

weighted_clique.fixtures: all symmetric 4x4 binary matrices generated locally

validation.known_answer_gate: final-outputs/tests-passed.json; bundle-outputs/tests-passed.json revalidates gate and reruns planted B/C

environment_and_tooling_reads: Required cloud-environment-runtime SKILL.md and references/networking.md (generic environment instructions, no C16 research)
GitHub exact-file retrieval metadata and requested branch ref via git ls-remote; no commit messages/diffs or repository tree
Process metadata for local search resource control; no environment/credential dumps
Installed generic solver/library APIs, version metadata and binary hashes; standard compiler/tool version commands
Newly written source, generated validation fixtures, logs and outputs in the isolated implementation directory

primary_search_parameters.branch_order: static descending compatibility degree; reverse greedy-color prefix order

recorded_timeline.timestamp_basis: mtime of flushed START real C marker; within wrapper-call overhead

timeout_limitations: Budgets are cooperative/approximate. Construction, coloring, checking and solver interrupt acknowledgement may add overhead. Redundant paused SAT B acknowledged the original deadline interrupt after about 17 additional seconds; it remains INCOMPLETE and actual elapsed time is retained.
